body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea GYROID EROSION: at the left grip the body is a smooth, ordered light-grey shell of soft vertical tube ribs like image[2]; moving right the shell is eaten away along a ragged erosion front, exposing a matte black gyroid lattice, the print infill made visible, over a solid inner wall. The gyroid cells shrink and densify toward the lens and fuse into one gloss-black ring round it, like the photon ring in image[3]. Light-grey shell islands float in the lattice. The open gyroid over the electronics is the vent; translucent cells on top glow as charge-light pipes. image[4] = ribbed lens ring with red index triangle. image[5] = knurled pads and red accents. Collared shutter, recessed switch, plugged port on the left end, corner strap eyelet, shadow-gap seam, visible layer lines. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
